name: io.github.YananLee/typemotion-art
title: TypeMotion.art
description: Browse TypeMotion.art text animation templates and shot effects. Read-only and public.

tools.name: describe_capabilities
tools.description: Summarize what this public TypeMotion.art MCP can do and link to website docs.

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: List TypeMotion.art template families such as video, text animation, maps, charts, and titles.

tools.name: list_templates
tools.description: Browse public TypeMotion.art templates. Filter by category or fuzzy query.

category.description: Optional category such as video, text-animation, text, spacetype, maps, tables, diagrams, or titles.

query.description: Optional fuzzy match against template id, name, or description.

tools.name: list_shots
tools.description: Browse the Shot Motion library of cinematic text and UI effects.

category.description: Optional shot category such as typography, opening, transition, or camera.

query.description: Optional fuzzy match against shot id, name, or description.

tools.name: list_tool_pages
tools.description: List search-intent tool pages such as typing animation maker or lower third maker.

tools.name: list_use_cases
tools.description: List practical video use cases with recommended templates.

tools.name: recommend_templates
tools.description: Recommend TypeMotion.art templates from a creative goal or keyword query.

goal.description: What the user wants to make, such as YouTube intro, travel map, or lower third.
